failure_mode_ledger_check: (1) Flipper kick power benchmark APPLIES — must hit 1500+ px/s per Williams T2 baseline (was 696 in cyber-pinball P0)
(2) Response latency APPLIES — must be ≤16.6ms input-to-flipper-state-change (was 117ms in cyber-pinball P0)
(3) Ball-saver-on-spawn APPLIES — first ball must spawn into flipper-reachable zone, not into drain. Auto-launch from shooter lane resolves; spawn-to-flipper-arc within 1 physics second mandatory
(4) AI license drift NOT applicable (no AI gen)
(5) Deploy config gotcha APPLIES — vercel.json cleanUrls + outputDirectory cross-check mandatory (cyber-pinball had cleanUrls strip privacy.html)
(6) User-as-tester FAILURE — never end ship turn with 'test on device'. QA dispatch BEFORE 'done' message. THIS IS THE MAIN INCIDENT TO PREVENT.
(7) Layer A green but Layer B unscored APPLIES — both must run before ship
(8) YELLOW shipped APPLIES — convert to GREEN or RED, never YELLOW

(9) Hint-stacking in response to 'amacı ne anlamadım' WRONG (DROP failure pattern) — fix mechanic clarity at visual layer, not text overlays. Pinball silhouette = self-evident; if ambiguity occurs, fix the SHAPE/MOTION, not the COPY
